Sharing & albums.content: They added search to the Add To Album popup! Someone *is* reading all those feedbacks I send!!! Easy backup of photos and videos. Nice interface for browsing photos and videos. Sometimes fails or errors out, but not too bad. Video creator is mostly automatic but I like the amount of tweaking it provides (adjusting music, filter, and titles).

It doesn't have select all option in any album. So for selecting 2000 photos of last 5-6 years, it takes a hell lot of time. Also, it doesn't detect all device folders and after backing up a device folder, it should make an album of that name, but it doesn't make it. Such an useless app. Even after so many years , you didn't add these features...

This is one of the best apps for photos. Live album is too good. It recognizes photos from the camera store and organises in the album without an error. I have my kids album and anytime i click a new photo it is able to to select her pic and add to album. Update : One more feature should be added. It should segregate photos which are not part of any album. It will be easier to clear clutter.

At first this app annoyed me, I didn't like that it listed all of my photos it what seemed like a cluttered way. But it's actually amazing. All of my photos from 2006 forward are on here, plus I can easily search by face, date, location, subject matter, color - anything! And it's easy to make albums to keep things organized the way I want. When I change phones, everything automatically comes with.

There's two major flaws with Google Photos in my opinion - the fact that your photos are automatically sorted into albums/there's no way to browse all photos, and the Save Copy function instead of having the choice to overwrite the original photo. These two small details really bring down the user experience for me and I'd love to see Google offer a more streamlined app!

I love the throwback pictures it brings to relive your memories, the collage, the wide range of options you get using the app too. I would love Google photo to add a feature that can enable you group your pictures according to a type, for examples faces together and bags or shoes together, automatically, without having to create an album, and selecting manually.

I love how the app will give me photo edits suggestions for collage photos from my album. I really like the option to stack photos now that are similar. The amount of storage you get for free is decent but it doesn't cost much to upgrade as well. And then when you upgrade, you get additional features to use within the camera settings as well, which is pretty cool

Awesome app if your text savvy. And even if you're not, all you got to do is read and follow the directions. It may get frustrating at times, but it gets easier. You can put things in different spots and albums, and such, and free up space even though it's in another space under the same 15 gig limit... A lot of stuff can be done. I switching things around.

Thank you Google.

Customer support.content: I have had several Tracfones over a few years. I have never had a problem activating a new one. It couldn't be easier and that's saying a lot since I am an 81 yr young gr/mother. Live Customer service reps are fantastic in all respects. Only thing I don't like is automatic operator. I guess we can't win them all. Perhaps one day with new technology.

Make sure if you're using Google photos that you constantly make sure your photos are actually being backed up. Just because your photos are on there does not mean they are uploaded to the app. I lost a year's worth of photos and contacted someone about it and no one ever got back to me to even try to resolve my issues. Horrible app with horrible customer service.

Amazing !!!! After losing my pictures in 2009 due to a new phone, I swore never to save anything on any of phones. I moved to Google Photos, Contacts, Drive, and Calender. I have been through more than 5 phones android and iPhones. I have never never lost any photos, contacts, documents, etc. I love it!!!!! Thanks Google! And Google One is the best to access great customer support.
